title: Herb-Roasted Turkey Breast with Spiced Apple & Bourbon Chutney
ingredients: Turkey: 1 bone-in, skin-on turkey breast (approx. 4.5 lbs)
1 tsp garlic powder (or 3 cloves minced garlic)
1/3 tsp dried rosemary (crushed or finely ground)
Chutney: 2 tbsp extra virgin olive oil
3 medium tart cooking apples (e.g., Granny Smith or Honeycrisp), peeled and diced
Pinch of crushed red pepper flakes
instructions: Preheat oven to 375°F (190°C). Line or lightly oil a baking sheet with a wire rack, or use a roasting pan.
Season: Pat turkey breast dry with paper towels. In a small bowl, combine 2 tbsp olive oil, garlic powder, sage, thyme, rosemary, 1 1/2 tsp kosher salt and black pepper.
Rub: Rub half of the spice mixture under the skin and spread the remainder evenly over the skin.
Roast: Place turkey skin-side up on the rack. Roast 60 to 75 minutes, until an instant-read thermometer reads 165°F (74°C) in the thickest part without touching bone.
Chutney, sauté: Heat 2 tbsp olive oil in a saucepan over medium heat. Add red onion and cook 4 to 5 minutes until soft.
Chutney, deglaze: Remove pan from heat briefly, pour in bourbon, return to stove and simmer 1 to 2 minutes to reduce.
Chutney, simmer: Add apples, cider vinegar, brown sugar, water, cinnamon, ginger, cloves, red pepper flakes and 1/2 tsp salt. Bring to a boil.
Chutney, thicken: Reduce heat to medium-low and cook uncovered 15 to 20 minutes, stirring occasionally, until apples are tender and sauce has reduced to a rich chutney.
notes: Serving = ~6 oz carved turkey breast with 3 tbsp chutney. Nutrition is an estimate per serving, based on 6 servings, skin-on roasted turkey breast with rendered pan fats dripped off, and full consumption of the chutney. Includes ~9 g added sugars, 110 mg cholesterol, 2.5 g saturated fat.
